form: Guides only: rules in the guide, CI, a Makefile and a pull request template; no skills.

work.does: For each work item in plan.md that is not done: build it the way its test column says (test-first or test-after), run its tests, commit it once, and mark it done. Work sent back to build is a new row. Do not start the next item while a test of this item fails. Branch: topic/<issue>-<slug>. End each commit body with Refs #<issue>.

gate.name: refs-issue
gate.run: range=$(git log --format=%H "$AF_BASE_SHA..$AF_HEAD") && [ -n "$range" ] && for c in $range; do git log -1 --format=%B "$c" | grep -q 'Refs #' || exit 1; done

memory: a change to what summary returns needs the person: such tasks are high
